name: bot.suwappu/mcp
description: Cross-chain, x402-metered DEX execution for AI agents — quote, execute, and track swaps across 14+ chains (12 EVM + Solana + TRON), plus portfolio, perps, prediction-market, and lending reads. Streamable HTTP transport, read tools free/public, write tools pay-per-call.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer <SUWAPPU_API_KEY>. Required for write/scoped tools and any metered read (get_quote, get_portfolio, get_prices, etc). NOT required for the four public read tools (list_chains, list_tokens, get_tempo_tokens, browse_mpp_directory). Register a free key at POST https://api.suwappu.bot/v1/agent/register.

bot.suwappu/tools.name: get_quote
bot.suwappu/tools.description: Get a swap quote for exchanging tokens across EVM (Li.Fi), Solana (Jupiter), and Tempo (internal router).

bot.suwappu/tools.name: execute_swap
bot.suwappu/tools.description: Execute a swap from a previously obtained quote_id; returns an unsigned transaction to sign.

bot.suwappu/tools.name: simulate_swap
bot.suwappu/tools.description: Dry-run a swap (balance/allowance/gas/eth_call checks) with zero funds moved.

bot.suwappu/tools.name: get_swap_status
bot.suwappu/tools.description: Get the status of a previously executed swap.

bot.suwappu/tools.name: get_swap_history
bot.suwappu/tools.description: Paginated swap history for the authenticated agent.

bot.suwappu/tools.name: get_portfolio
bot.suwappu/tools.description: Token balances and USD portfolio value for a wallet across all supported chains.

bot.suwappu/tools.name: get_prices
bot.suwappu/tools.description: Current USD prices with 24h change for up to 20 symbols.

bot.suwappu/tools.name: list_chains
bot.suwappu/tools.description: List all supported blockchain networks. Public, no API key required.

bot.suwappu/tools.name: list_tokens
bot.suwappu/tools.description: List available tokens on a chain. Public, no API key required.

bot.suwappu/tools.name: get_tempo_tokens
bot.suwappu/tools.description: TIP-20 token list on Tempo mainnet. Public, no API key required.

bot.suwappu/tools.name: browse_mpp_directory
bot.suwappu/tools.description: Browse the third-party MPP service directory (directory.mpp.dev). Public, no API key required.

bot.suwappu/tools.name: list_wallet_policies
bot.suwappu/tools.description: List Turnkey spending/whitelist policies on the agent's managed wallet.

bot.suwappu/tools.name: predict_markets
bot.suwappu/tools.description: Search and browse Polymarket prediction markets.

bot.suwappu/tools.name: predict_market
bot.suwappu/tools.description: Detailed prediction market info with live CLOB midpoint prices per outcome.

bot.suwappu/tools.name: predict_book
bot.suwappu/tools.description: Live CLOB order book for every outcome of a prediction market.

bot.suwappu/tools.name: predict_price
bot.suwappu/tools.description: Live CLOB midpoint prices for every outcome of a prediction market.

bot.suwappu/tools.name: predict_trades
bot.suwappu/tools.description: Recent trades across all outcomes of a prediction market.

bot.suwappu/tools.name: perps_markets
bot.suwappu/tools.description: List HyperLiquid perpetual futures markets.

bot.suwappu/tools.name: perps_quote
bot.suwappu/tools.description: Quote a HyperLiquid perpetual position (entry, margin, liquidation price, funding, fees).

bot.suwappu/tools.name: perps_positions
bot.suwappu/tools.description: Open HyperLiquid perpetual positions for a wallet.

bot.suwappu/tools.name: lend_markets
bot.suwappu/tools.description: List Morpho lending markets on a chain (APY, LLTV, utilization, TVL).

bot.suwappu/tools.name: lend_market
bot.suwappu/tools.description: Detail for a single Morpho lending market by ID.

bot.suwappu/payment.challenge: HTTP 402 with X-Payment-Required (base64 JSON) + Accept-Payment headers, and an accepts[] body per the x402 spec, when prepaid credit balance is insufficient
